extraction_text: Section 12.9 As consistent with RCW 41.56, the City agrees to bargain impacts on wages, hours and working conditions that result from the implementation of the Advanced Meter conversion.

attributes.context: The passage appears in the CBA section headed ARTICLE 18 – AUTOMATION.

extraction_text:
In order for employees to better prepare themselves for the skill requirements of the future, and in fulfillment of its obligation to provide information to the Union, the City will provide a briefing to the Union as soon as practical the introduction of technological change which may affect employees. During these briefings, the City will inform the Union of anticipated schedules of introduction of new technology.

The City will make every effort to provide training opportunities to equip employees with the skills necessary to make the transition of applicable technological changes.
